processor: Chip-Scale Atomic Magnetometer (CSAM) + MEMS Vapor Cell Platform
notes: Kitching NIST chip-scale atomic magnetometer. Cell volume: 12 mm^3. Power: 195 mW. Sensitivity: 50 pT/sqrt(Hz) at 10 Hz (chip scale). Much less sensitive than SERF OPMs (10 fT) due to smaller cell volume and operation outside SERF regime. Recent 2024 PMC review confirms active state of chip-scale atomic devices field. MEMS vapor cell work for Rydberg sensors (2025 arXiv:2509.01911) is more demanding: higher temperature, optical access constraints. Practical chip-scale Rydberg sensor not yet commercially available as of 2026. Key message: chip-scale magnetometer (50 pT) vs lab SERF OPM (10 fT) vs SQUID (3 fT) - three orders of magnitude sensitivity range across form factors.
